shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' lib/api.ts && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,200p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && git status --short && rg -n \"getPosts|unstable_cache|cacheLife|cacheTag|Blog Posts|posts\" . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"declare function cacheLife|export.*cacheLife|declare function cacheTag|function unstable_cache\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -100 && rg -n 'cacheComponents' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:next.config.ts && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .gitignore && git ls-files next-env.d.ts .next tsconfig.json && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -type f | wc -l && find .next -type d | wc -l && ls -l next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'mv .next /tmp/codex-workspace-next-build && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
